title: WaterColor "Slice of 30A" 1680 E. County Hwy 30A #103
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 6 wristbands.- Located in WaterColor's Beach District- 1 block from WaterColor Town Center- Free WiFi- Washer/Dryer- 2 adult bikes provided- Bedside outlet USB chargers- Parking throughout community- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, a third pool with zero-entry, an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico. DETAILS: Located just steps from crystal clear water in WaterColor's Beach District, 1680 E. County Highway is a 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom condo with wonderful accommodations. In addition to upgraded appliances and other enhancements in this unit, guests will also have access to the WaterColor Beach Club and all resort amenities, including the racquet club, nature trails, and complimentary bikes. The first floor includes an entry and laundry room with a full-size washer and dryer and both guest rooms. The first guest room features a queen bed and 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds with a private bathroom. The primary bedroom next door includes a plush king bed. The second-floor living area encompasses a living room, kitchen, and dining room all in one. The living room opens to a covered balcony offering glimpses of emerald Gulf waters and is furnished with a pair of cozy sofas and several chairs grouped around a large flat-screen TV. Up to 6 guests can dine at the glass-topped dining table, with a place for 4 more at the adjacent breakfast bar. The kitchen's crisp white cabinets also front the stainless-steel refrigerator and dishwasher and are accented with white quartz countertops. A half bath completes this level. This unit offers the best of both worlds, being just a block from the Town Center, a short walk to Seaside, and an even closer distance to the beach! It's the perfect location for those looking to stay near all of the action. Don't miss your chance to stay in the award-winning community of WaterColor and book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed and Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Watercolor Community HOA prohibits the rental of Low-Speed Vehicles for guests staying in the Town Center.
